svg.aria-label: Diagram of the insurance pack's record types. Four structured types across the top: policyholder, eighty five percent individual and fifteen percent corporate, carrying a national identity number for individuals and a tax number for companies; policy, one to four per policyholder, across seven branches, carrying a vehicle plate that is emitted unlabeled and no make or model field at all; claim, zero to two per policy, carrying claimed and paid amounts and a labeled anomaly kind; and payment, one, three or twelve per policy, carrying a masked card number when paid by card and an IBAN when paid by transfer. Two document types below in red, each producing a label sidecar: claim note of sixty to a hundred and eighty words, and call transcript with alternating turns. A band across the bottom states the health boundary: this pack touches a health branch and is not a clinical dataset, with no diagnosis, treatment, medication or prognosis.
svg.title: What the insurance pack emits
svg.desc: Four structured record types, two document types, and the health boundary stated across the bottom.
